notes: 3D Grid-Snapping Base Builder, PBR Graphics Overhaul & Custom .GLB Asset Framework
Interactive 3D & 2D 16×16 Grid Base Builder: build bases directly inside the 3D tactical view or 2D Layout blueprint with cell snapping, collision prevention, and live 3D ghost preview
15 buildable compound structures (including T-Wall barriers and Patriot SAM batteries) that grant real gameplay bonuses to Defense, Perimeter Security, QoL, and Ammo/Fuel Storage
Pluggable 3D Asset Framework: click '📦 Load .GLB' in the Base Builder (or call window.registerITCModel) to replace any placeholder structure with your own custom .GLB/.GLTF 3D model
3D Graphics Engine Overhaul: ACES Filmic tone mapping, sRGB output encoding, PCF soft directional sunlight shadows on High quality, and PBR MeshStandardMaterial shaders
